title: T10 — Project context diagram (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Project Context Diagram — T10 SAFe cadence and MSP tranches

## Context

T10 is the programme's delivery machinery: it turns an approved PI plan into cards, gates the
demo on evidence, requires retro lessons, reviews each tranche against the record, and ties
benefit realisation to a measured baseline. It sits inside the conveyor tenant `nonagentic`,
programme `01a1d039-0d24-7d16-ae52-4841e96ccfac`, tranche 4.

## Affected organisation

| Actor | Role |
|---|---|
| Programme architect (`conveyor-e2e`) | delivery and the record |
| `conveyor-approver` | approval, distinct from the requester |
| Architecture Board (`conveyor-architecture-board`) | approves the A–D set and the delivery contract |
| Programme board | reviews the tranche |

## Affected systems

- **conveyor store** — `programme_cadence`, `demo_gate`, `retro`, `tranche_review`,
  `benefit_transition` and the WBS/WSJF rows.
- **the server cadence job** — the PI tick (`apps/server/tests/cadence_jobs.rs`).
- **the board and backlog** — cards materialised by WSJF within the WIP slots.
- **the decision ladder (T2)** and **the plan spine (T1)** — adjacent contracts T10 depends on.
